summary: Flat kerb on a wide residential road, homes 14-25 m away.
reasons: Homes 14-25 m away on both sides
Few cars park here, mostly residents

drivers.traffic: Through street with moderate traffic, junction at the east end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park on the north kerb (2022 image), some in Esri; looks like resident parking, no sign of camping.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees to the north give some shade in the morning and at midday.

best_section.where: Waverley Road north kerb, between the two driveways east of the large white house, before the corner
